name: Markarian
band_note: mean of blouse entry $895 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13); hand-band
why: Women's eveningwear, embellished dresses and separates around $1,100–$2,000, plus made-to-order bridal, sold through its own site, New York studio and Saks.
origin: Founded in New York, United States in 2017 by Alexandra O'Neill.

quote.q: The sky that I saw when I was young was infinite, and that is what I loved most about it. The magic of those childhood moments still inspires me.

opview: “The sky that I saw when I was young was infinite, and that is what I loved most about it. The magic of those childhood moments still inspires me.” — Alexandra O'Neill, founder, About Us, markarian-nyc.com

facts_read.source: brand site (about, RTW collections, AW26 collection, terms); saksfifthavenue.com brand page; Vinted catalogue search; TRR designer index (2026-10-13 list); B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: Markarian women's ready-to-wear; EXCLUDED: gowns (46), Larroudé by Markarian shoes and Markarian x Gigi Burris hats (collaborations), hair accessories

doors.note: JUDGEMENT CALL: only physical presence is an appointment-only NYC showroom (Flatiron district, Thu–Sun, bridal + RTW private consultations); street address not published. Counted as 1 own door — reviewer may prefer to treat as showroom (not a store). Stockists page loads via JS widget ('Cargando sucursales...'), not read.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 82 of 157 styles (180 feed records less Larroudé shoes, hair accessories and headwear = 158 listings; one product per style); composition f

craft_evidence.owned: no — 'designed and produced in New York City', supporting 'the New York Garment Center'; no workroom or factory named
craft_evidence.madein: ~95% (78 of 82 sampled styles say 'Made in the USA')
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed — founded in New York City in 2017 by Alexandra O'Neill
craft_evidence.process: partial — made-to-order to reduce waste; hand-beading named on styles; no making process published
craft_evidence.reasoning: Almost every product page says 'Made in the USA' and the about page says production is in New York's Garment Center, with a made-to-order model, but no workroom or maker is named and the house owns nothing it shows. A consistently stated place of making with nothing named behind it is a 2.
